To set up signatures in Outlook, follow these steps:

1. Open Outlook and click on the File tab.
2. In the menu list on the left side of the Account Information screen, select Options.
3. On the Outlook Options dialog box, select Mail from the list of options on the left side of the dialog box.
4. On the Mail screen, select Signatures in the Compose messages section.
5. Click New under the Select signature to edit box on the Signatures and Stationery dialog box.
6. Enter a descriptive name for the signature in the edit box and click OK.
7. Click Save.
8. You can create separate signatures for business and personal emails by repeating steps 5-7 and giving each signature a different name.
9. To set a signature as your default, select the desired signature from the drop-down menu under Select signature to edit.
10. To include images or other formatting elements in your signature, go to the Mail Format tab and check the box next to Include stationery from your file system.
